name: DCG Cables & Wires Ltd.
summary: DCG Cables & Wires Ltd. operates in the industrial electrical segment, specializing in the manufacturing and export of a diverse range of copper cables and wires. The company's primary products include bare copper strips and wires, paper-covered copper strips and wires (including Kraft, Crepe, Nomex, and Mica types), super enamelled copper wires, copper tapes, fiberglass-covered copper strips and wires, copper submersible wires, copper busbars/flats, copper round bars, single core cables, twin twisted flexible wires, three coat flexible cables, multi-paper covered connection wires, and enamelled copper winding wires. DCG Cables & Wires Ltd. primarily serves transformer manufacturers across India, operating within the business-to-business (B2B) segment. Its products are also supplied to various industrial clients for applications such as electrical wiring, power distribution, grounding systems, and construction materials. The company is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, with manufacturing facilities in Ahmedabad and Vadodara.
